title: SYSTEMATIC EVALUATION OF LLM-AS-A-JUDGE IN LLM ALIGNMENT TASKS: EXPLAINABLE METRICS AND DIVERSE PROMPT TEMPLATES

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the difference in the LLM judge's selection probability when the order of the two candidate responses is reversed, utilizing a mathematical de-noising process to account for the model's self-inconsistency (flipping noise).

Measuring the difference in the LLM judge's alignment with human preference when the human-preferred response is longer versus when it is shorter, applying a de-noising process to mitigate the impact of flipping noise.
